fusions.name: Kedge Line
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed hook into the first enemy in its path and winches you up to 7 tiles to it. It deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaff in Passing
fusions.desc: Gaffs the target as you pass. It deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grapple Swing
fusions.desc: Snags a hold ahead and swings you 7 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Caught in the Spokes
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
